end.summary:
Practised levels of organisation using human and plant examples.
Yash gave correct examples of organs and tissues on two attempts.
They practised ordering cell, tissue, organ, organ system and organism.
Yash initially mixed up an organ with its organ system, then corrected this using the football-team analogy.
Teach-back was not passed; ordering remained incorrect in the final record.
end.parentNote: Asha practised how cells form tissues, tissues form organs, and organs work together in organ systems. Yash used heart, digestive, respiratory and circulatory examples, and corrected the mix-up between the heart and circulatory system during the lesson. At home, ask them to arrange the five levels with one human and one plant example for each.
